evidences.evidence_quote: By measuring the subtle vibrations of objects, mmWave [22], [23], [24] and RFID [25] technologies can eavesdrop on human speech.
evidences.evidence_context: The application of radio frequency (RF) technology is becoming increasingly widespread, bringing along with it concerns regarding security and privacy. By measuring the subtle vibrations of objects, mmWave [22], [23], [24] and RFID [25] technologies can eavesdrop on human speech.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” in Proc. ACM Interactive, Mobile, Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文在相关工作中使用[25]作为RFID窃听技术的一个例子，但这是一处成组引用（与[22],[23],[24]并列），正文没有具体描述目标论文的能力或贡献，属于普通参考文献列举。根据规则，成组引用且无单独描述应排除。
